title: Slow Cooker Lentil Vegetable Soup
description: A hands-off hearty soup made with lentils, vegetables, tomatoes, and broth.

steps.text: Put 1 1/2 cups rinsed lentils, 1 diced onion, 2 diced carrots, 2 diced celery stalks, 1 can diced tomatoes, 6 cups broth, 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning, and 1/2 teaspoon salt in the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on LOW 7 hours, until the lentils and vegetables are tender.
Taste and add more salt or broth if needed before serving.

title: Slow Cooker Chicken & Gravy
description: Very tender chicken in simple savory gravy for spooning over potatoes, rice, or noodles.

ingredients.item: boneless skinless chicken breasts or thighs

steps.text: Place 2 lb chicken in the slow cooker.
Whisk 1 packet chicken gravy mix, 1 can cream of chicken soup, 1/2 cup chicken broth, and 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder. Pour over the chicken.
Cover and cook on LOW 6 hours, until the chicken is very tender.
Shred or slice the chicken in the gravy and serve over rice, noodles, or mashed potatoes.

title: Slow Cooker Applesauce
description: Hands-off homemade applesauce that uses up a bag of softening apples.

steps.text: Put 3 lb chopped apples, 1/2 cup water, and 1 teaspoon cinnamon in the slow cooker. Add optional brown sugar and lemon juice if you want them.
Cover and cook on LOW 4 hours, until the apples collapse easily.
Mash for chunky applesauce or blend carefully for smooth applesauce. Cool before refrigerating.

title: Small-Batch Brownies
description: Fudgy brownies sized for an 8x4-inch loaf pan so there are not dozens left over.

steps.text: Heat oven to 350°F. Line or grease an 8x4-inch loaf pan.
Whisk 4 tablespoons melted butter with 1/2 cup sugar, 1 egg, and 1/2 teaspoon vanilla.
Stir in 1/4 cup cocoa, 1/3 cup flour, and 1/8 teaspoon salt just until no dry flour remains. Fold in optional 1/4 cup chocolate chips.
Spread in the pan and bake 20–22 minutes, until the edges are set and a toothpick has moist crumbs rather than wet batter.
